title: With my hands lifted up
lyrics_original: And my mouth filled with praise
With a heart of thanks giving
I will bless Thee, O Lord.
I will bless Thee, O Lord,
I will bless Thee, O Lord,
With a heart of thanks giving
I will bless Thee, O Lord.

bible_verses.english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.
Through him then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which acknowledge his name.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come before You today with a heart overflowing with gratitude. I lift my hands and open my mouth to declare Your goodness and faithful love. Teach me to bless You not only in moments of joy, but in every circumstance of my life. May my worship be a sweet sacrifice that brings honor to Your name. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I come before You today with a heart overflowing with gratitude. I lift my hands and open my mouth to declare Your goodness and faithful love. Teach me to bless You not only in moments of joy, but in every circumstance of my life. May my worship be a sweet sacrifice that brings honor to Your name. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: True worship engages our entire being—our hands, our lips, and our hearts. When we lift our hands and fill our mouths with praise, we align our body and spirit to honor the God who loves us completely. Even in quiet or difficult seasons, choosing a heart of thanksgiving becomes a beautiful sacrifice of praise to the Lord. As you sing today, let your posture reflect the deep gratitude and reverence you carry for Jesus.
